# Model options

Every option the launch screen offers, as the catalog describes it. Limits and terms change often: each figure says whether the provider states it (*official*), someone else reports it (*third_party*) or it could not be found in the provider's documentation (*unverified*), with its source. Check your provider's console for your own limits.

> Free tiers are meant for testing with sample networks such as the bundled IEEE case. For real or confidential grid data, use Local (Ollama) or a paid tier whose terms fit your organisation.

## Free

Hosted, no cost. Rate-limited; for testing with sample networks.

### Gemini API · free tier

**What you need:** A Google account; the key is created in Google AI Studio.

**Getting started**

1. Go to [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) and sign in with any Google account — no payment needed for the free tier.
2. Click Get API key, then Create API key, and copy it.
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Default model:** `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`

| Model | Context | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` | 1,048,576 tokens | 15 requests/min, 250,000 tokens/min, 500 requests/day. Google's rate-limit page points to AI Studio for per-model numbers. (unverified, [source](https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit)) |
| `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` | 1,048,576 tokens | 15 requests/min, 250,000 tokens/min, 500 requests/day (unverified, [source](https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit)) |
| `gemini-3.8-flash` · advanced, few questions a day | 1,048,576 tokens | 5 requests/min, 250,000 tokens/min, 20 requests/day (unverified, [source](https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit)) |
| `gemini-3.6-flash` · advanced, few questions a day | 1,048,576 tokens | 5 requests/min, 250,000 tokens/min, 20 requests/day (unverified, [source](https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit)) |
| `gemini-3-flash-preview` · advanced, few questions a day | 1,048,576 tokens | 5 requests/min, 250,000 tokens/min, 20 requests/day (unverified, [source](https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit)) |

**Data:** Google may use free-tier prompts and responses to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them. In the EEA, Switzerland and the UK the paid-tier data terms apply instead (no use for product improvement). ([terms](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### NVIDIA Build · free endpoints

**What you need:** A free NVIDIA Developer account with phone verification. Verification is not available in every country (it worked with a Spanish number); NVIDIA asks users who cannot verify to write to help@build.nvidia.com.

**Getting started**

1. Sign in to [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com), or create a free NVIDIA Developer account.
2. Verify your phone number when asked — it is required to create keys and is not available in every country (if yours is missing, write to help@build.nvidia.com).
3. Create an API key at [build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys](https://build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys). It starts with nvapi-.
4. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Default model:** `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b`

| Model | Context | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b` | 1,000,000 tokens | — |
| `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b` | 1,000,000 tokens | — |
| `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b` | 1,000,000 tokens | — |
| `z-ai/glm-5.3` | 1,048,576 tokens | — |
| `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` | 1,048,576 tokens | — |
| `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 1,048,576 tokens | — |

**Limits (per account):** 40 requests/min, 10,000 requests/day. "Up to 40 rpm" and "10,000 requests per day" on each model card; may vary by model and traffic. (official, [source](https://build.nvidia.com/z-ai/glm-5-3))

**Data:** For development and testing only, per NVIDIA's API trial terms. NVIDIA records inputs and outputs to provide the trial and to improve its products and services, including AI models. ([terms](https://assets.ngc.nvidia.com/products/api-catalog/legal/NVIDIA%20API%20Trial%20Terms%20of%20Service.pdf))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### OpenRouter · free models

**What you need:** An OpenRouter account; no card needed for free models.

**Getting started**

1. Create an account at [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai) — no card is needed for free models.
2. Create an API key at [openrouter.ai/settings/keys](https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys).
3. Optional: choose which providers may use your prompts at [openrouter.ai/settings/privacy](https://openrouter.ai/settings/privacy).
4. Paste the key on the launch screen.

**Limits (per account):** 20 requests/min, 50 requests/day. 1,000 requests/day once $10 of credit has ever been bought; no published TPM. (official, [source](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api_reference/limits))

**Models:** listed live on the launch screen.

**Data:** OpenRouter does not store prompts unless you opt in, but each model's provider has its own policy, and free-model hosts may store prompts and train on them. CONDUCTOR allows them by default, because excluding them currently leaves no free model working. ([terms](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

## Paid

Hosted, paid per token. Limits depend on your plan.

### OpenAI API

**What you need:** Paid per token.

**Getting started**

1. Go to [platform.openai.com/api-keys](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) — an account with credit is needed (no free tier).
2. Click Create new secret key and copy it.
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Data:** API data is governed by OpenAI's business terms; see the link. ([terms](https://openai.com/policies/business-terms/))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### Anthropic API (Claude)

**What you need:** Paid per token.

**Getting started**

1. Go to [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) — an account with credit is needed (no free tier).
2. Click Create Key and copy it.
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Data:** API data is governed by Anthropic's commercial terms; see the link. ([terms](https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### Gemini API · paid tier

**What you need:** A Google Cloud billing account linked to the AI Studio project.

**Getting started**

1. Go to [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) and sign in.
2. Link a Google Cloud billing account to the project, then create an API key.
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Default model:** `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`

**Data:** Paid-tier prompts are not used to improve Google's products; they are logged for a limited period for abuse detection. ([terms](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### OpenRouter · paid models

**What you need:** Paid per token from your OpenRouter credit.

**Getting started**

1. Create an account at [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai) and add credit.
2. Create an API key at [openrouter.ai/settings/keys](https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys).
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Models:** listed live on the launch screen.

**Data:** Each model's provider has its own data policy; OpenRouter's privacy settings choose which you allow. ([terms](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### DeepSeek API

**What you need:** Pay-as-you-go; new accounts reportedly get a one-time signup credit first.

**Getting started**

1. Create an account at [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com).
2. Create an API key at [platform.deepseek.com/api_keys](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys); top up when any signup credit runs out.
3. Paste it on the launch screen.

**Default model:** `deepseek-flash`

| Model | Context | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 1,048,576 tokens | — |

**Limits (per account):** Limited by concurrency (2,500 requests for deepseek-flash), not per minute or day. (official, [source](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/rate_limit))

**Data:** DeepSeek's privacy policy says personal data is processed and stored in the People's Republic of China and may be used to train and improve its technology. Whether API inputs are used for training is not stated in its platform terms. ([terms](https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html))

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

### Other OpenAI-compatible endpoint

**What you need:** Any server speaking OpenAI's chat-completions API (Azure, vLLM, …) via a base URL.

**Getting started**

1. Get your endpoint's base URL (it ends in /v1), an API key, and the name of a model that supports tool calling.
2. Paste them on the launch screen — the base URL goes in the Base URL field.

**Data:** Governed by the endpoint's operator.

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*

## Local

Runs on this machine. No grid data leaves it.

### Local model (Ollama)

**What you need:** No account. Needs a tool-capable model and enough memory.

**Data:** No grid data leaves your machine.

*Last verified 2026-10-14.*
